brief: 🚀 TOP PICK: Skills/prompts library (opp 9) — Curated agent skill packs are the new "npm for AI agents." Build a marketplace or framework before the category consolidates.
💡 ADJACENT WINNERS: Context databases (OpenViking) + multi-agent dashboards (orca) — Agents need memory and orchestration. These solve the two hardest problems in agentic systems.
⚡ BREAKOUT TIMING: Q1 is the window. OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google are all racing to ship agent frameworks. Whoever owns the skill ecosystem wins the platform.
📈 SIGNAL: 3 separate agent-skills repos flagged this cycle. When multiple independent builders converge on the same primitive, the market is validating the thesis.
🎯 QUICK ENTRY: Start with a narrow vertical (code, sales, research). Curate 20-50 battle-tested skills, add versioning + testing, and own one domain before going horizontal.

items.name: mattpocock/skills

VS Code extension to browse and inject skills into any AI assistant
Team skill library with versioning and collaborative editing
items.monetization: Freemium marketplace with premium curated skill packs; B2B licensing for enterprise teams
items.why_now: AI agent adoption is accelerating exponentially and 236k stars prove massive developer demand for ready-made agent configurations

items.name: stablyai/orca

Agent orchestration layer - chain multiple agents together with retry logic and fallbacks using your own API keys

items.why_now: AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex) are exploding with 23% weekly growth, and every AI-generated doc needs diagrams that don't look like garbage

items.name: volcengine/OpenViking

Agent skill marketplace - pre-built toolkits (web scraping, calendar, email) that agents can discover and invoke
RAG knowledge base SaaS - drag-drop PDF/URLs, get a retrieval API to pipe context into any agent
items.monetization: Freemium with per-API-call pricing; paid tiers for higher throughput, longer context windows, and team collaboration features
items.why_now: AI agents are exploding but memory infrastructure is fragmented - whoever wins context wins the agent wars

items.name: virgiliojr94/book-to-skill

IDE plugin: inline book reference panel that auto-suggests relevant passages based on cursor context

items.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
items.one_liner: AST-based code knowledge graphs for AI coding assistants
items.pain_point: Devs using AI coding tools hit context limits on large codebases; Graphify solves this by indexing code as queryable graphs instead of embeddings, so solo devs and teams get reliable code understanding without vector store overhead
app_ideas: VS Code extension showing interactive code architecture maps with clickable function/data flow
GitHub Action that auto-generates PR summaries by querying the codebase knowledge graph
Local-first code Q&A app: drop in a repo, chat with it like a senior dev who knows every edge case
items.monetization: freemium for solo devs (local use free, cloud sync + team features paid) + B2B API wrapper for teams wanting graph queries in their CI/CD
items.why_now: AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) are exploding but still struggle with large codebases; Graphify rides that wave with a deterministic, no-vector-store approach that feels more trustworthy for production codebases
